## Evidence

- [ ] I read the applicable repository standards.
- [ ] Each changed file has one primary responsibility.
- [ ] Dependencies point toward the owner of policy.
- [ ] Boundaries use explicit typed contracts.
- [ ] Focused tests cover behavior and failure.
- [ ] `make verify` passes.
- [ ] I reviewed the fresh complete diff against the design inventory.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`; see CONTRIBUTING.md and DCO).
